record.provider: pixelfed.de — Pixelfed, 15 MB per object, unlimited per account

free_tier.stated: Per-account unlimited (Pixelfed has no per-user storage counter). Per-file image_size_limit = video_size_limit = 15360000 bytes (14.6 MiB); 12 attachments per status; image_matrix_limit 2,073,600 px (1920x1080).

egress.terms: Free, plain CDN path, no meter.

record.tooling: Pixelfed is a Mastodon-API derivative: POST /api/v1/media (multipart) then POST /api/v1/statuses with media_ids[]. OAuth2 via /api/v1/apps. Any Mastodon client library mostly works.
record.chaining: Per-object uploads are limited to 14.6 MiB and restricted to image and video formats (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, MP4). Federation across open Pixelfed instances provides distribution across nodes, though single-file limits remain small.
record.limits_note: Per-object-cap 14.6 MiB; per-account unlimited; supported MIME restricted to image/jpeg,png,gif,webp + video/mp4. No arbitrary blobs (PNG/JPEG wrapper needed).

identity_cost.detail: the registration form asks name, username, email, password and a box confirming the user is at least 16 years old; no phone or card field

record.reliability_note: pixelfed.social itself returned HTTP 521 (origin down) throughout this probe; pixelfed.art also 521. The software is fine, the flagship host was not.
record.confidence_note: reported: the pages read on 2026-11-03 are https://pixelfed.de/api/v1/instance, which states registrations true with approval_required false, image_size_limit and video_size_limit of 15360000, the MIME types image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif, image/webp and video/mp4, and max_media_attachments 12, and https://pixelfed.de/register, which shows a form with an age-confirmation box. Neither page states a per-account storage quota, so the 'unlimited per account' value of free_tier.stated is not confirmed by them and the rung stays reported.

evidence.proved: probe: GET -> 200, configuration.media_attachments.image_size_limit=15360000, video_size_limit=15360000, image_matrix_limit=2073600, statuses.max_media_attachments=12, registrations=true, version 3.5.3 (Pixelfed 0.15.1)
image and video per-file limits are both 15360000 bytes
the registration form carries a 16-years-old box after the name, username, email and password fields
evidence.quote: I am at least 16 years old

evidence.proved: registrations are open and need no approval
the instance JSON states the per-file image limit of 15360000 bytes
